          HOW TO CREATE A DECK

          On Home, press + New Deck and name it. The deck opens on Configure, where you add content.

          WHAT YOU CAN ADD

          Speak: tap the microphone and ask a question, give a research topic or speak your content.

          Type or paste: a question, a research topic or text.

          Documents: PDF, Word, Excel, CSV and text files.

          Camera and files: photos, videos and audio, from the camera or from this device.

          Links: web pages, YouTube videos and audio links.

          Every item appears in the contents list, and every item is used.

          WHAT YOU GET

          One go makes everything: an audiobook in parts with an AI voice, a PDF booklet with pictures, PPT slides with pictures, flashcards and a quiz.

          Each part is kept at full depth. Everything is saved on this device, so it works offline.

          HOW IT HELPS

          Lumidex saves hours of research, study and revision for students, researchers and anyone who must learn a subject fast.

          Research, Reflect and Revise: research the topic, reflect on it with flashcards and the quiz, then revise with the audiobook, booklet and slides.

          BACKUP

          Backups work only in Chrome and Edge. If the Backup tab is not visible, your browser does not support backups.

          Add a free Google key in Settings for best results
